quarterly_data.signal: Upstream targets and projects per the 20-F: at Capital Markets Day 2025 Shell said it would grow top-line production across its combined Upstream and Integrated Gas business by 1% (CAGR) per year to 2030, sustaining its 1.4 million barrels per day of liquids production to 2030. Orca (formerly Gato do Mato, Brazil): in January 2026 Shell increased its interest in Orca from 50% to 70% following the completion of a swap agreement with TotalEnergies, and in February 2026 agreed to sell a 20% interest to Kuwait Petroleum Exploration Company; following completion, subject to regulatory approvals, Shell will maintain a 50% interest. Shell Brasil operates the project with partners Ecopetrol (30%) and PPSA as the contract manager, and Orca now moves into execution. Norway: the Ormen Lange Phase 3 subsea compression project was completed and delivered first gas in June 2025; Shell calls it the world's deepest subsea compression system and expects it to increase the field recovery rate from 75% to 85%, unlocking an additional 30–50 billion cubic metres of gas to supply Europe.
quarterly_data.figure: production growth 1% (CAGR) per year to 2030; liquids 1.4 million barrels per day to 2030; Orca interest from 50% to 70%, 20% to be sold, 50% retained; Ormen Lange recovery from 75% to 85%, additional 30–50 billion cubic metres

quarterly_data.signal: Integrated Gas backfill projects per the 20-F: Shell and its partners took an FID in June 2025 to develop Egypt's Mina West gas field (discovered October 2023) as a subsea tieback to the existing West Delta Deep Marine (WDDM) concession infrastructure (Shell interest 50%), which supplies gas to the domestic market and the Egyptian LNG plant; Shell will operate Mina West with a 60% interest. In Australia the Crux platform jacket was installed offshore Western Australia in 2025; the platform will supply backfill gas to the Prelude FLNG facility, the Phase 1 drilling campaign delivered five wells and was completed in 2025, 78 days ahead of schedule, and subsea pipelay completed three months early. An FID was also taken on the Gorgon Stage 3 backfill development, which will connect the offshore Geryon and Eurytion gas fields to Gorgon's existing subsea gas gathering infrastructure and processing facilities on Barrow Island to help maintain production at Gorgon.
quarterly_data.figure: Mina West FID June 2025, Shell operator with 60% interest; Crux Phase 1 five wells, 78 days ahead of schedule; Gorgon Stage 3 FID

quarterly_data.signal: Low-carbon businesses per the 20-F: the Northern Lights CO2 transport and storage venture has agreements with Yara and Ørsted to transport and store CO2 from facilities in the Netherlands and Denmark. Shell announced final investment decisions on Project Polaris, the carbon capture project at Shell Energy and Chemicals Park Scotford in Canada, alongside Project Atlas, a carbon storage hub developed in partnership with ATCO EnPower; the first phase of Atlas will provide permanent underground storage for CO2 captured by Polaris. Holland Hydrogen I in the Netherlands is expected, in Shell's words, to be Europe's largest green hydrogen plant at 200 MW once operational. Shell acquired Nature Energy in 2023 and by 2025 operated 17 biogas plants across Europe and the USA; Shell says it became one of the world's largest traders and suppliers of SAF, accounting for close to 20% of SAF sales in North America and Europe through Shell Aviation.
quarterly_data.figure: Holland Hydrogen I 200 MW; 17 biogas plants; close to 20% of SAF sales in North America and Europe
